chapters.title: The whole argument on one screen
chapters.lead: Four panels, left to right: HG002's own two chromosome 3 ends (his mother's copy, then his father's), then the reference genome's chromosome 11 end and chromosome 3 end. Every panel starts at the telomere.
notes: Molecules on his own assembly: 3 of 3 nanopore molecules (from 3 datasets) align to the mother's copy and run from the telomere straight through the junction.
The assembly on the reference: the mother's copy starts with a chromosome-11-like block (38 kb; 99.5% identical to CHM13 chr11p, 92.6% to chr3q), then chromosome 3 (99.7% identical).

The molecules on the reference, cut at their switch: part 1 carries chr11p's letter at 491 of 500 diagnostic sites (chr3q's at 9); part 2 carries chr3q's letter at 81 of 84 diagnostic sites (chr11p's at 3).
The father's copy (right of the mother's) carries a different allele, SA-3q-04.

chapters.lead: A single nanopore read (ont_ul_dorado, 3788f60a-2f28-4b28-917b-f1ecae3645e3): 1.7 kb of telomere, then a switch at 33.0-40.5 kb.
notes: Top track: cut at the switch. Part 1, aligned to the chromosome 11 end, carries chr11's letter at 163 of 166 diagnostic sites; part 2, aligned to the chromosome 3 end, carries chr3's letter at 27 of 28. Zoom in on the orange and blue ticks of the claim-model track to see single sites.
Bottom two tracks: the same molecule, uncut, aligned to each end alone (primary alignment). Each end accounts for only its own part of the molecule.

chapters.title: Two copies of chromosome 3, two different ends
chapters.lead: HG002 inherited two different chromosome 3 ends. Left: his mother's copy (a chromosome-11-like block, then 3q). Right: his father's copy (19p-like blocks among 3q sequence).
notes: Each set of molecules lands on its own copy: 3 of 3 maternal-claim molecules on the left window, 6 of 6 paternal-claim molecules on the right one.
The built-in control: the same chromosome arm, in the same person, read by the same machines, gives two different and internally consistent ends.

chapters.title: Passed from mother to son
chapters.lead: HG002's maternal chromosome 9 end starts with chromosome-15-like DNA. Molecules from HG002 (top) and from his mother HG004 (bottom), sequenced separately.
notes: Son: part 1 carries chr15q's letter at 466 of 473 diagnostic sites (chr9p's at 6); part 2 carries chr9p's letter at 120 of 120 diagnostic sites (chr15q's at 0).
Mother: part 1 carries chr15q's letter at 440 of 455 diagnostic sites (chr9p's at 9); part 2 carries chr9p's letter at 112 of 114 diagnostic sites (chr15q's at 2).
Switch lower bounds: son 20, 24, 25, 26, 24, 20 kb; mother 32, 29, 29, 29, 29, 24 kb.
An assembly error is not inherited; a real chromosome end is.

chapters.title: The same junction in 8 unrelated people
chapters.lead: SA-20q-01: the chromosome 20q end starts with a block of 3q/19p-type DNA. About half of all assembled 20q ends carry it. One track per person; 1000 Genomes nanopore data (Schloissnig et al. 2025), independent of the assemblies.
notes: 8 people, 21 molecules. The two CHM13 ends share no block here, so the evidence is sequence found in only one of them: part 1 covers 3q-only sequence in 21 of 21 molecules, part 2 covers 20q-only sequence in 21 of 21.
These are older R9.4.1 reads, so mismatches are denser than in HG002. The switch sits in the same region in everyone, because it is one inherited allele.

chapters.title: Every sequencing technology agrees
chapters.lead: HG002's maternal chromosome 19q end starts with chromosome-22-like DNA. One molecule from each of 9 HG002 datasets: hifi revio 3cells, hifi revio pbmay24, hifi sprq 30hr, hifi vega 24hr, ont duplex, ont lc24 ulk, ont q28, ont r941 recall, ont ul dorado.
notes: Diagnostic sites carrying the expected letter, part 1 (22q) and part 2 (19q): ont lc24 ulk: 56/57 and 48/53; ont ul dorado: 55/56 and 47/53; ont r941 recall: 53/56 and 47/51; ont q28: 56/57 and 48/53; ont duplex: 56/57 and 48/53; hifi vega 24hr: 56/57 and 48/53; hifi sprq 30hr: 56/57 and 48/53; hifi revio pbmay24: 56/57 and 48/53; hifi revio 3cells: 56/57 and 48/53.
Different chemistries, error profiles and labs; the same switch.

chapters.title: A block from 200 kb inside another chromosome
chapters.lead: SA-17p-02 (about 1 in 5 assembled 17p ends): the 17p end starts with a copy of sequence that, in the reference genome, lies about 200 kb inside the chromosome 11p end.
notes: 5 people: HG002 17p, HG002 17p, HG003 17p, HG01258 17p, HG03130 17p. Part 1 covers 11p-only sequence in 20 of 20 molecules (left panel, 190-230 kb into 11p).
This block is rich in tandem repeats, so alignments look ragged.
